theorem imo_1964_p1a (n : ℕ) : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by 
  have h_main : (n % 3 = 0) ↔ (2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) := by
    have h : ∀ n : ℕ, (2^n % 7 = 1) ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
      intro n
      rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n 3]
      have : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases this with (h₁ | h₁ | h₁) <;>
        simp [h₁, pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod]
      <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try
          {
            induction n / 3 <;> simp [*, pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod] at * <;>
              norm_num at * <;> omega
          }) <;>
        (try
          {
            ring_nf at *
            <;> omega
          })
      <;>
        omega
    have h₁ : (2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) ↔ 2^n % 7 = 1 := by
      simp [Nat.ModEq]
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : (2^n % 7 = 1) ↔ n % 3 = 0 := h n
    exact h₂.symm
  
  have h_solution_set : n ∈ solution_set ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
    simp only [solution_set, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    <;>
    aesop
  
  have h_final : n ∈ solution_set ↔ 2^n ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    rw [h_solution_set]
    rw [h_main]

  have h_a_pos : 0 < a := by
    exact hf.1
  
  have h_f_ge_half : ∀ x, f x ≥ 1 / 2 := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : f x = f ((x - a) + a) := by ring_nf
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : f ((x - a) + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2) := by
      have h₃ := hf.2 (x - a)
      exact h₃.2
    rw [h₂]
    have h₃ : Real.sqrt (f (x - a) - (f (x - a)) ^ 2) ≥ 0 := by
      apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
    linarith
  
  have h_main_identity : ∀ x, f (x + a) - (f (x + a))^2 = (f x - 1 / 2)^2 := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : f (x + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) := by
      have h₂ := hf.2 x
      exact h₂.2
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ f x - (f x) ^ 2 := by
      have h₃ := hf.2 x
      nlinarith [h₃.1]
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have h₄ : (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) - (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)) ^ 2 = (f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [hf.2 x |>.1] : 0 ≤ f x - (f x) ^ 2),
        sq_nonneg (f x - 1 / 2), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)),
        hf.2 x |>.1]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [hf.2 x |>.1] : 0 ≤ f x - (f x) ^ 2),
      sq_nonneg (f x - 1 / 2), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (f x - (f x) ^ 2)),
      hf.2 x |>.1]
  
  have h_period_two_a : ∀ x, f (x + 2 * a) = f x := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : f (x + 2 * a) = f ((x + a) + a) := by ring_nf
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : f ((x + a) + a) = 1 / 2 + Real.sqrt (f (x + a) - (f (x + a)) ^ 2) := by
      have h₃ := hf.2 (x + a)
      exact h₃.2
    rw [h₂]
    have h₃ : f (x + a) - (f (x + a)) ^ 2 = (f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
      apply h_main_identity
    rw [h₃]
    have h₄ : Real.sqrt ((f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2) = f x - 1 / 2 := by

      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> nlinarith
    rw [h₄]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> linarith [h_f_ge_half x]
  
  have h_final : ∃ b, 0 < b ∧ f.Periodic b := by
    refine' ⟨2 * a, by linarith, _⟩
    
    
    
    intro x
    have h₁ : f (x + 2 * a) = f x := h_period_two_a x
    simpa [add_assoc] using h₁
  
  exact h_final

        have h₅₁ : 0 ≤ 1 / (x^3 * z) := by positivity

            field_simp [hx.ne', hz.ne']

            <;> ring_nf

            <;> field_simp [hx.ne']

        <;> ring_nf

    exact h₄
  
  have h₂ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + a * (b + c) / 4 ≥ 1 / a := by

        have h₂₅ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + a * (b + c) / 4 ≥ 1 / a := h₁ a (b + c) ha (by linarith)

    exact h₂₃
  
  have h₃ : 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + b * (c + a) / 4 ≥ 1 / b := by

  have h₅ : (1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b))) + (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
    
    have h₅₁ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + a * (b + c) / 4 ≥ 1 / a := h₂
    have h₅₂ : 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + b * (c + a) / 4 ≥ 1 / b := h₃

      calc

        _ = 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by ring
    exact h₅₄
  
  have h₆ : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by

    nlinarith [ha, hb, hc]

      have h₇₇ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
      have h₇₈ : 0 < a * b * c := by positivity

    have h₇₉ : 1 / c = a * b := by

      have h₇₁₁ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
      have h₇₁₂ : 0 < a * b * c := by positivity
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
      nlinarith
    calc
      _ = 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by rfl
      _ = b * c + a * c + a * b := by
        rw [h₇₁, h₇₅, h₇₉]
        <;> ring

  have h₈ : (1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b))) + (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≥ a * b + b * c + c * a := by
    
    calc

      _ ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
        
        linarith [h₅]

  have h₉ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by

  have h₁₀ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := by

      mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hc ha, sq_nonneg (a * b - b * c),

  linarith

theorem imo1995_p2 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (habc : a * b * c = 1) :
    3 / 2 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := by 
  have h₁ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) = (b*c)^2 / (a * (b + c)) := by
    have h₁₁ : a ^ 3 * (b + c) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₂ : a * (b + c) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₃ : (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) := rfl
    have h₁₄ : 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) := by
      have h₁₅ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
      have h₁₆ : (b * c) ^ 2 = 1 / a ^ 2 := by
        calc
          (b * c) ^ 2 = (b * c) ^ 2 := rfl
          _ = (1 / a) ^ 2 := by
            have h₁₇ : b * c = 1 / a := by
              have h₁₈ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
              field_simp [ha.ne'] at h₁₈ ⊢
              nlinarith
            rw [h₁₇]
          _ = 1 / a ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [ha.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [ha.ne']
            <;> nlinarith
      calc
        1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) = 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) := rfl
        _ = (1 / a ^ 2) / (a * (b + c)) := by
          field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
        _ = (b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) := by
          rw [h₁₆]
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
    rw [h₁₄]
  
  have h₂ : 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) = (c*a)^2 / (b * (c + a)) := by
    have h₂₁ : b ^ 3 * (c + a) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₂₂ : b * (c + a) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₂₃ : (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) = (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) := rfl
    have h₂₄ : 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) = (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) := by
      have h₂₅ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
      have h₂₆ : (c * a) ^ 2 = 1 / b ^ 2 := by
        calc
          (c * a) ^ 2 = (c * a) ^ 2 := rfl
          _ = (1 / b) ^ 2 := by
            have h₂₇ : c * a = 1 / b := by
              have h₂₈ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
              field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne'] at h₂₈ ⊢
              nlinarith
            rw [h₂₇]
          _ = 1 / b ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
            <;> nlinarith
      calc
        1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) = 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) := rfl
        _ = (1 / b ^ 2) / (b * (c + a)) := by
          field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
        _ = (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) := by
          rw [h₂₆]
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
    rw [h₂₄]
  
  have h₃ : 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) = (a*b)^2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
    have h₃₁ : c ^ 3 * (a + b) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₃₂ : c * (a + b) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₃₃ : (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) = (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := rfl
    have h₃₄ : 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) = (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
      have h₃₅ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
      have h₃₆ : (a * b) ^ 2 = 1 / c ^ 2 := by
        calc
          ((a * b) : ℝ) ^ 2 = (a * b) ^ 2 := by norm_cast
          _ = (1 / c) ^ 2 := by
            have h₃₇ : a * b = 1 / c := by
              have h₃₈ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
              field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne'] at h₃₈ ⊢
              nlinarith
            rw [h₃₇]
          _ = 1 / c ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
            <;> nlinarith
      calc
        ((1 : ℝ) / (c ^ 3 * (a + b))) = (1 : ℝ) / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) := by rfl
        _ = (1 / c ^ 2) / (c * (a + b)) := by
          field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
        _ = (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
          rw [h₃₆]
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
          <;> nlinarith
    rw [h₃₄]
  
  have h₄ : (b*c)^2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c*a)^2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a*b)^2 / (c * (a + b)) ≥ (a*b + b*c + c*a)/2 := by
    have h₅ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
    have h₆ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
    have h₇ : 0 < c * a := by positivity
    have h₈ : 0 < a * (b + c) := by positivity
    have h₉ : 0 < b * (c + a) := by positivity
    have h₁₀ : 0 < c * (a + b) := by positivity
    have h₁₁ : 0 < a * b * (b * c) := by positivity
    have h₁₂ : 0 < a * b * (c * a) := by positivity
    have h₁₃ : 0 < b * c * (c * a) := by positivity
    
    have h₁₄ : ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) * (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) ≥ (b * c + c * a + a * b) ^ 2 := by
      
      have h₁₅ : 0 < a * (b + c) := by positivity
      have h₁₆ : 0 < b * (c + a) := by positivity
      have h₁₇ : 0 < c * (a + b) := by positivity
      
      have h₁₈ : ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) * (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) ≥ (b * c + c * a + a * b) ^ 2 := by
        
        field_simp [h₁₅.ne', h₁₆.ne', h₁₇.ne']
        rw [le_div_iff (by positivity)]
        
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b * c * (b * (c + a)) - c * a * (a * (b + c))),
          sq_nonneg (c * a * (c * (a + b)) - a * b * (b * (c + a))),
          sq_nonneg (a * b * (a * (b + c)) - b * c * (c * (a + b)))]
      linarith
    
    have h₁₅ : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by
      ring
    
    rw [h₁₅] at h₁₄
    
    have h₁₆ : 0 < a * b + b * c + c * a := by positivity
    have h₁₇ : ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
      
      have h₁₈ : ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) * (2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) ^ 2 := by
        linarith
      
      have h₁₉ : ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
        calc
          ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) = ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) := by rfl
          _ ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
            
            have h₂₀ : 0 < 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by positivity
            
            have h₂₁ : ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) * (2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a)) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) ^ 2 := by
              linarith
            
            have h₂₂ : ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
              calc
                ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) = ((b * c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c * a) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a * b) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b))) := by rfl
                _ ≥ (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 := by
                  
                  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * b + b * c + c * a)]
            linarith
      linarith
    linarith
  
  have h₅ : a*b + b*c + c*a ≥ 3 := by
    have h₅₁ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
    have h₅₂ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
    have h₅₃ : 0 < c * a := by positivity
    have h₅₄ : a * b * (b * c) * (c * a) = 1 := by
      calc
        a * b * (b * c) * (c * a) = (a * b * c) * (a * b * c) := by ring
        _ = 1 * 1 := by rw [habc]
        _ = 1 := by ring
    
    have h₅₅ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * b - b * c), sq_nonneg (b * c - c * a), sq_nonneg (c * a - a * b),
        mul_pos h₅₁ h₅₂, mul_pos h₅₂ h₅₃, mul_pos h₅₃ h₅₁]
    exact h₅₅
  
  have h₆ : (a*b + b*c + c*a)/2 ≥ 3/2 := by
    linarith
  
  have h₇ : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) ≥ 3/2 := by
    calc
      _ = (b*c)^2 / (a * (b + c)) + (c*a)^2 / (b * (c + a)) + (a*b)^2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
        rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
      _ ≥ (a*b + b*c + c*a)/2 := by
        exact h₄
      _ ≥ 3/2 := by
        linarith
  
  linarith

    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a ^ 2 * (b + c) - 2), sq_nonneg (a - 1),

    field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']

    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b ^ 2 * (c + a) - 2), sq_nonneg (b - 1),
      mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos ha hc, mul_pos hb hc,
      sq_nonneg (b * (c + a) - 2), sq_nonneg (b ^ 2 - 1)]

    field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
    rw [div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c ^ 2 * (a + b) - 2), sq_nonneg (c - 1),
      mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos ha hc, mul_pos hb hc,
      sq_nonneg (c * (a + b) - 2), sq_nonneg (c ^ 2 - 1)]
  
  have h_sum : 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) + (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c := by
    
    linarith [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  
  have h_simplify : (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) / 4 = (a*b + b*c + c*a) / 2 := by
    ring_nf at *
    all_goals nlinarith
  
  have h_inv : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = a*b + b*c + c*a := by
    
    have h₄ : 1 / a = b * c := by
      field_simp [ha.ne']

    have h₅ : 1 / b = a * c := by

    linarith [h_sum, h_simplify, h_inv]

    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a),
      mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hc ha,

theorem imo1995_p2 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)

    3 / 2 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := by 
  have h_titu : ∀ (x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : ℝ), 0 < y₁ → 0 < y₂ → 0 < y₃ → (x₁^2 / y₁ + x₂^2 / y₂ + x₃^2 / y₃) ≥ (x₁ + x₂ + x₃)^2 / (y₁ + y₂ + y₃) := by
    intro x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ hy₁ hy₂ hy₃
    have h₁ : 0 < y₁ + y₂ + y₃ := by linarith
    have h₂ : 0 < y₁ * y₂ := by positivity
    have h₃ : 0 < y₁ * y₃ := by positivity
    have h₄ : 0 < y₂ * y₃ := by positivity
    field_simp [h₁.ne', hy₁.ne', hy₂.ne', hy₃.ne']
    rw [div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x₁ * y₂ - x₂ * y₁), sq_nonneg (x₁ * y₃ - x₃ * y₁), sq_nonneg (x₂ * y₃ - x₃ * y₂),
      sq_nonneg (x₁ * y₂ + x₂ * y₁), sq_nonneg (x₁ * y₃ + x₃ * y₁), sq_nonneg (x₂ * y₃ + x₃ * y₂)]
  
  have h_main_ineq : (1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c)^2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := by
    have h₁ : 0 < a * (b + c) := by positivity
    have h₂ : 0 < b * (c + a) := by positivity
    have h₃ : 0 < c * (a + b) := by positivity
    have h₄ : (1 / a : ℝ) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (1 / b : ℝ) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (1 / c : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) ≥ (1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) := by
      
      have h₅ : (1 / a : ℝ) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (1 / b : ℝ) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (1 / c : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) ≥ (1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) := by
        
        have h₅₁ : 0 < a * (b + c) := by positivity
        have h₅₂ : 0 < b * (c + a) := by positivity
        have h₅₃ : 0 < c * (a + b) := by positivity
        have h₅₄ := h_titu (1 / a) (1 / b) (1 / c) (a * (b + c)) (b * (c + a)) (c * (a + b)) h₅₁ h₅₂ h₅₃
        
        ring_nf at h₅₄ ⊢
        linarith
      linarith
    
    have h₅ : (1 / a : ℝ) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) = 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) := by
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₆ : (1 / b : ℝ) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) = 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) := by
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
    have h₇ : (1 / c : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) = 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) := by
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
    
    calc
      ((1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c) : ℝ) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) ≤ (1 / a : ℝ) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c)) + (1 / b : ℝ) ^ 2 / (b * (c + a)) + (1 / c : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c * (a + b)) := by
        linarith
      _ = 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) := by
        rw [h₅, h₆, h₇]
        <;> ring_nf
  
  have h_denom : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := by
    ring_nf
    <;>
    linarith
  
  have h_num : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = a * b + b * c + c * a := by
    have h₁ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
    have h₂ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
    have h₃ : 0 < c * a := by positivity
    have h₄ : 0 < a * b * c := by positivity
    field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne', h₁.ne', h₂.ne', h₃.ne', h₄.ne']
    nlinarith [habc]
  
  have h_lower_bound : (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := by
    have h₁ : (1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c)^2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := h_main_ineq
    have h₂ : a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b) = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) := h_denom
    have h₃ : 1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c = a * b + b * c + c * a := h_num
    calc
      ((a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 : ℝ) = (1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c) ^ 2 / (a * (b + c) + b * (c + a) + c * (a + b)) := by
        rw [h₃]
        rw [h₂]
        field_simp [add_assoc]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne']
        <;> nlinarith [mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hc ha]
      _ ≤ 1 / (a ^ 3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b ^ 3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c ^ 3 * (a + b)) := by
        linarith
  
  have h_amgm : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := by
    have h₁ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
    have h₂ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
    have h₃ : 0 < c * a := by positivity
    have h₄ : a * b * (b * c) * (c * a) = 1 := by
      calc
        a * b * (b * c) * (c * a) = (a * b * c) * (a * b * c) := by ring
        _ = 1 * 1 := by rw [habc] <;> ring
        _ = 1 := by ring
    have h₅ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * b - b * c), sq_nonneg (b * c - c * a), sq_nonneg (c * a - a * b),
        mul_pos h₁ h₂, mul_pos h₂ h₃, mul_pos h₃ h₁]
    linarith
  
  have h_final : 3 / 2 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := by
    have h₁ : (a * b + b * c + c * a) / 2 ≤ 1 / (a^3 * (b + c)) + 1 / (b^3 * (c + a)) + 1 / (c^3 * (a + b)) := h_lower_bound
    have h₂ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≥ 3 := h_amgm
    linarith
  
  exact h_final

theorem imo2000_p2 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (habc : a * b * c = 1) :
    (a - 1 + 1 / b) * (b - 1 + 1 / c) * (c - 1 + 1 / a) ≤ 1 := by 
  have h_main : ∃ (x y z : ℝ), 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z ∧ a = x / y ∧ b = y / z ∧ c = z / x := by
    refine' ⟨a, 1, 1 / b, by linarith, by norm_num, by positivity, _, _, _⟩
    · 
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne']
      <;>
      nlinarith [ha, hb]
    · 
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne']
      <;>
      nlinarith [ha, hb]
    · 
      have h₁ : c = 1 / (a * b) := by
        have h₂ : a * b * c = 1 := habc
        have h₃ : c = 1 / (a * b) := by
          field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne'] at h₂ ⊢
          nlinarith
        exact h₃
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne', h₁]
      <;>
      ring_nf
      <;>
      field_simp [ha.ne', hb.ne']
      <;>
      nlinarith [ha, hb]
  
  have h_final : (a - 1 + 1 / b) * (b - 1 + 1 / c) * (c - 1 + 1 / a) ≤ 1 := by
    obtain ⟨x, y, z, hx, hy, hz, ha_eq, hb_eq, hc_eq⟩ := h_main
    have h₁ : (a - 1 + 1 / b) = (x + z - y) / y := by
      have h₂ : a = x / y := ha_eq
      have h₃ : b = y / z := hb_eq
      rw [h₂, h₃]
      field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    have h₂ : (b - 1 + 1 / c) = (y + x - z) / z := by
      have h₃ : b = y / z := hb_eq
      have h₄ : c = z / x := hc_eq
      rw [h₃, h₄]
      field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    have h₃ : (c - 1 + 1 / a) = (z + y - x) / x := by
      have h₄ : c = z / x := hc_eq
      have h₅ : a = x / y := ha_eq
      rw [h₄, h₅]
      field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith
    rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
    have h₄ : ((x + z - y) / y) * ((y + x - z) / z) * ((z + y - x) / x) = (x + z - y) * (y + x - z) * (z + y - x) / (x * y * z) := by
      field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hz.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₄]
    have h₅ : (x + z - y) * (y + x - z) * (z + y - x) ≤ x * y * z := by
      
      by_cases h₆ : (x + z - y) ≤ 0
      · 
        have h₇ : (x + z - y) * (y + x - z) * (z + y - x) ≤ 0 := by
          
          have h₈ : 0 < x := hx
          have h₉ : 0 < y := hy
          have h₁₀ : 0 < z := hz
          
          have h₁₁ : y + x - z > 0 := by
            nlinarith [h₈, h₉, h₁₀]
          
          have h₁₂ : z + y - x > 0 := by
            nlinarith [h₈, h₉, h₁₀]
          
          have h₁₃ : (x + z - y) ≤ 0 := h₆
          have h₁₄ : (y + x - z) > 0 := h₁₁
          have h₁₅ : (z + y - x) > 0 := h₁₂
          have h₁₆ : (x + z - y) * (y + x - z) ≤ 0 := by
            nlinarith
          nlinarith
        
        have h₁₇ : 0 < x * y * z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      · 
        by_cases h₇ : (y + x - z) ≤ 0
        ·

    have h₁₀ : 0 < x := by linarith
    have h₁₁ : 0 < y := by linarith
    have h₁₂ : 0 < z := by linarith

      field_simp [h₁₀.ne', h₁₁.ne', h₁₂.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₁₀.ne', h₁₁.ne', h₁₂.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> linarith
    rw [h₁₃]
    rw [h]
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h₂ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1))^2 ≤ (x + y + z) * ((x - 1) / x + (y - 1) / y + (z - 1) / z) := by
    have h₂₁ : 0 ≤ √(x - 1) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
    have h₂₂ : 0 ≤ √(y - 1) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
    have h₂₃ : 0 ≤ √(z - 1) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
    have h₂₄ : 0 < x := by linarith
    have h₂₅ : 0 < y := by linarith
    have h₂₆ : 0 < z := by linarith
    have h₂₇ : 0 ≤ (x - 1) / x := by
      apply div_nonneg
      · linarith
      · linarith
    have h₂₈ : 0 ≤ (y - 1) / y := by
      apply div_nonneg
      · linarith
      · linarith
    have h₂₉ : 0 ≤ (z - 1) / z := by
      apply div_nonneg
      · linarith
      · linarith
    
    have h₃₀ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1))^2 ≤ (x + y + z) * ((x - 1) / x + (y - 1) / y + (z - 1) / z) := by
      
      calc
        (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1)) ^ 2 =
            (√x * √((x - 1) / x) + √y * √((y - 1) / y) + √z * √((z - 1) / z)) ^ 2 := by
          have h₃₁ : √(x - 1) = √x * √((x - 1) / x) := by

            have h₃₁₂ : 0 ≤ (x : ℝ) := by linarith

            rw [h₃₂₆]

            rw [h₃₃₄]
            have h₃₃₆ : √(z * ((z - 1) / z)) = √z * √((z - 1) / z) := by
              rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
            rw [h₃₃₆]
          rw [h₃₁, h₃₂, h₃₃]

        _ ≤ (x + y + z) * ((x - 1) / x + (y - 1) / y + (z - 1) / z) := by

          have h₃₅ : 0 ≤ √y := Real.sqrt_nonneg y

    exact h₃₀

        have h₁₇ : √(x - 1) = √x * √((x - 1) / x) := by

  have h₄ : (√(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1))^2 ≤ x + y + z := by

theorem singapore2019_r1_p4 (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.logb 21 3 = x) :
    Real.logb 7 9 = solution x := by 
  have h₁ : Real.logb 21 3 = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := by
    rw [Real.logb]
    <;>
    simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_pow]
    <;>
    field_simp
    <;>
    ring
  
  have h₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
    have h₂₁ : Real.log 21 = Real.log (3 * 7) := by norm_num
    rw [h₂₁]
    have h₂₂ : Real.log (3 * 7) = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    rw [h₂₂]
    <;>
    norm_num
  
  have h₃ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by
    have h₃₁ : Real.logb 21 3 = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := h₁
    have h₃₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h₂
    have h₃₃ : Real.logb 21 3 = x := hx
    calc
      x = Real.logb 21 3 := by rw [hx]
      _ = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := by rw [h₁]
      _ = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by
        rw [h₂]
        <;>
        field_simp
        <;>
        ring
  
  have h₄ : Real.log 3 > 0 := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h₅ : Real.log 7 > 0 := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h₆ : x > 0 := by
    have h₆₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
    rw [h₆₁]
    have h₆₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := h₄
    have h₆₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := h₅
    have h₆₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith
    positivity
  
  have h₇ : x < 1 := by
    have h₇₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
    rw [h₇₁]
    have h₇₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := h₄
    have h₇₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := h₅
    have h₇₄ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > Real.log 3 := by linarith
    have h₇₅ : Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
      <;> nlinarith
    linarith
  
  have h₈ : 1 - x > 0 := by
    have h₈₁ : x < 1 := h₇
    linarith
  
  have h₉ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3) * (1 - x) / x := by
    have h₉₁ : x = Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
    have h₉₂ : Real.log 3 > 0 := h₄
    have h₉₃ : Real.log 7 > 0 := h₅
    have h₉₄ : x > 0 := h₆
    have h₉₅ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 > 0 := by linarith
    have h₉₆ : Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₉₇ : x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) = Real.log 3 := by
      calc
        x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) = (Real.log 3 / (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7)) * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by rw [h₉₁]
        _ = Real.log 3 := by
          field_simp [h₉₆]
          <;> ring
          <;> field_simp [h₉₆]
          <;> linarith
    have h₉₈ : x * Real.log 7 = Real.log 3 * (1 - x) := by
      calc
        x * Real.log 7 = x * Real.log 7 := rfl
        _ = x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) - x * Real.log 3 := by ring
        _ = Real.log 3 - x * Real.log 3 := by rw [h₉₇]
        _ = Real.log 3 * (1 - x) := by ring
    have h₉₉ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3) * (1 - x) / x := by
      have h₉₁₀ : x ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have h₉₁₁ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := by
        calc
          Real.log 7 = (x * Real.log 7) / x := by
            field_simp [h₉₁₀]
            <;> ring
          _ = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := by
            rw [h₉₈]
            <;> field_simp [h₉₁₀]
            <;> ring
          _ = (Real.log 3 * (1 - x)) / x := by rfl
      rw [h₉₁₁]
      <;> ring
    exact h₉₉
  
  have h₁₀ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 := by
    have h₁₀₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = Real.log 9 / Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      <;>
      simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_pow]
      <;>
      field_simp
      <;>
      ring
    rw [h₁₀₁]
    have h₁₀₂ : Real.log 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
      have h₁₀₃ : Real.log 9 = Real.log (3 ^ 2) := by norm_num
      rw [h₁₀₃]
      have h₁₀₄ : Real.log (3 ^ 2) = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
        rw [Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
      rw [h₁₀₄]
    rw [h₁₀₂]
    <;>
    field_simp
    <;>
    ring
    <;>
    norm_num
  
  have h₁₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * x / (1 - x) := by
    have h₁₁₁ : Real.logb 7 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 / Real.log 7 := h₁₀
    rw [h₁₁₁]
    have h₁₁₂ : Real.log 7 = (Real.log 3) * (1 - x) / x := h₉
    rw [h₁₁₂]
    have h₁₁₃ : x > 0 := h₆
    have h₁₁₄ : 1 - x > 0 := h₈
    have h₁₁₅ : Real.log 3 > 0 := h₄
    have h₁₁₆ : (Real.log 3 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₁₁₇ : (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [h₁₁₆, h₁₁₇]
    <;>
    ring_nf
    <;>
    field_simp [h₃, h₁₁₆, h₁₁₇] at *
    <;>
    nlinarith
  
  have h₁₂ : Real.logb 7 9 = solution x := by
    rw [h₁₁]
    <;>
    simp [solution]
    <;>
    ring_nf
    <;>
    field_simp
    <;>
    linarith
  
  apply h₁₂

    rw [h₁₃]
    <;> ring

              nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a' + b' + c' + d'), sq_nonneg (a' - b'), sq_nonneg (a' - c'), sq_nonneg (a' - d'), sq_nonneg (b' - c'), sq_nonneg (b' - d'), sq_nonneg (c' - d')]
        _ = 52 - (a' ^ 4 + b' ^ 4 + c' ^ 4 + d' ^ 4) := by rfl
    have h₃₄ : a' ^ 4 + b' ^ 4 + c' ^ 4 + d' ^ 4 ≤ 16 := by
      have h₃₄₁ : (a' ^ 2 + b' ^ 2 + c' ^ 2 + d' ^ 2) ^ 2 = 16 := by
        calc
          (a' ^ 2 + b' ^ 2 + c' ^ 2 + d' ^ 2) ^ 2 = 4 ^ 2 := by rw [h₃₂]
          _ = 16 := by norm_num
      have h₃₄₂ : 0 ≤ a' ^ 2 * b' ^ 2 + a' ^ 2 * c' ^ 2 + a' ^ 2 * d' ^ 2 + b' ^ 2 * c' ^ 2 + b' ^ 2 * d' ^ 2 + c' ^ 2 * d' ^ 2 := by
        positivity
      calc
        a' ^ 4 + b' ^ 4 + c' ^ 4 + d' ^ 4 ≤ (a' ^ 2 + b' ^ 2 + c' ^ 2 + d' ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a' ^ 2 - b' ^ 2), sq_nonneg (a' ^ 2 - c' ^ 2), sq_nonneg (a' ^ 2 - d' ^ 2), sq_nonneg (b' ^ 2 - c' ^ 2), sq_nonneg (b' ^ 2 - d' ^ 2), sq_nonneg (c' ^ 2 - d' ^ 2)]
        _ = 16 := by rw [h₃₄₁]
    calc
      S = 52 - (a' ^ 4 + b' ^ 4 + c' ^ 4 + d' ^ 4) := by rw [h₃₃]
      _ ≥ 52 - 16 := by
        
        gcongr
        <;>
        linarith
      _ = 36 := by norm_num
  
  exact ⟨h₃, h₂⟩

theorem imo_sl_2016_A5b_part2 (N) :
    ∃ n > N, ¬∃ a b, 0 < b ∧ b ≤ n.sqrt ∧ b ^ 2 * n ≤ a ^ 2 ∧ a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (n + 1) := by 
  have h_main : ∃ (m : ℕ), (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1 > N := by
    use N
    have h₁ : (N + 1) ^ 2 + 1 > N := by
      nlinarith
    exact h₁
  
  have h_final : ∃ n > N, ¬∃ a b, 0 < b ∧ b ≤ n.sqrt ∧ b ^ 2 * n ≤ a ^ 2 ∧ a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (n + 1) := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h_main
    use (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1
    constructor
    · 
      exact hm
    · 
      intro h
      obtain ⟨a, b, hb_pos, hb_sqrt, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
      have h₃ : b ≤ ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1).sqrt := by simpa using hb_sqrt
      have h₄ : 0 < b := hb_pos
      have h₅ : b ^ 2 * ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) ≤ a ^ 2 := by simpa using h₁
      have h₆ : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) + 1) := by simpa using h₂
      
      have h₇ : b ≤ m + 1 := by
        
        have h₇₁ : ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1).sqrt < m + 2 := by
          
          apply Nat.sqrt_lt.mpr
          norm_num
          <;> ring_nf at *
          <;> nlinarith
        have h₇₂ : ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1).sqrt ≥ m + 1 := by
          
          apply Nat.le_sqrt.mpr
          norm_num
          <;> ring_nf at *
          <;> nlinarith
        have h₇₃ : b ≤ ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1).sqrt := h₃
        omega
      
      by_cases h₈ : b = m + 1
      · 
        have h₉ : b = m + 1 := h₈
        have h₁₀ : (m + 1) ^ 2 * ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) ≤ a ^ 2 := by
          calc
            (m + 1) ^ 2 * ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) = b ^ 2 * ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) := by rw [h₉]
            _ ≤ a ^ 2 := h₅
        have h₁₁ : a ^ 2 ≤ (m + 1) ^ 2 * (((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) + 1) := by
          calc
            a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) + 1) := h₆
            _ = (m + 1) ^ 2 * (((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) + 1) := by rw [h₉]
        
        have h₁₂ : a ^ 2 > ((m + 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m + 1)]
        have h₁₃ : a ^ 2 < ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m + 1)]
        
        have h₁₄ : a ≤ (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - (m + 1) ^ 2)]
        have h₁₅ : a ≥ (m + 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - (m + 1) ^ 2)]
        omega
      · 
        have h₉ : b ≤ m := by
          omega
        
        have h₁₀ : (b * (m + 1) + 1) ^ 2 > b ^ 2 * (((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) + 1) := by
          cases b with
          | zero => contradiction 
          | succ b' =>
            simp [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc] at h₉ ⊢
            ring_nf at h₉ ⊢
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b' + 1), sq_nonneg (m + 1)]
        
        have h₁₁ : a ≤ b * (m + 1) := by
          
          have h₁₂ : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) + 1) := h₆
          have h₁₃ : (b * (m + 1) + 1) ^ 2 > b ^ 2 * (((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) + 1) := h₁₀
          have h₁₄ : a < b * (m + 1) + 1 := by
            by_contra h₁₅
            have h₁₆ : a ≥ b * (m + 1) + 1 := by omega
            have h₁₇ : a ^ 2 ≥ (b * (m + 1) + 1) ^ 2 := by
              calc
                a ^ 2 ≥ (b * (m + 1) + 1) ^ 2 := by
                  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_left (by omega) 2
                _ = (b * (m + 1) + 1) ^ 2 := by rfl
            nlinarith
          omega
        have h₁₂ : (b * (m + 1)) ^ 2 < b ^ 2 * ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) := by
          cases b with
          | zero => contradiction 
          | succ b' =>
            simp [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]
            ring_nf
            <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m + 1)]
        
        have h₁₃ : a ^ 2 < b ^ 2 * ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) := by
          calc
            a ^ 2 ≤ (b * (m + 1)) ^ 2 := by
              exact Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_left (by omega) 2
            _ < b ^ 2 * ((m + 1) ^ 2 + 1) := h₁₂
        
        omega
  
  exact h_final

theorem imo_sl_2019_A1 (h : N ≠ 0) {f : Int → Int} :
    (∀ a b : Int, f (N * a) + N * f b = f (f (a + b)))
      ↔ (f = λ _ ↦ 0) ∨ ∃ c : Int, f = (N * · + c) := by 
  have h_imp : (∀ a b : Int, f (N * a) + N * f b = f (f (a + b))) → (f = λ _ ↦ 0) ∨ ∃ c : Int, f = (N * · + c) := by
    intro hf
    have h₁ : ∀ b : Int, f 0 + N * f b = f (f b) := by
      intro b
      have h₂ := hf 0 b
      ring_nf at h₂ ⊢
      linarith
    have h₂ : ∀ a : Int, f (N * a) = N * f a + (1 - N) * f 0 := by
      intro a
      have h₃ := hf a 0
      have h₄ := h₁ a
      have h₅ := h₁ 0
      ring_nf at h₃ h₄ h₅ ⊢
      linarith
    have h₃ : ∀ a : Int, f (a + 1) - f a = f 1 - f 0 := by
      intro a
      have h₄ := hf a 1
      have h₅ := h₂ a
      have h₆ := h₁ (a + 1)
      have h₇ := h₁ 1
      have h₈ := h₁ 0
      ring_nf at h₄ h₅ h₆ h₇ h₈ ⊢
      have h₉ : (N : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (N : ℤ) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast h)
      nlinarith
    
    have h₄ : ∃ (k d : ℤ), ∀ (n : ℤ), f n = k * n + d := by
      use (f 1 - f 0), f 0
      intro n
      have h₅ : ∀ (n : ℤ), f n = (f 1 - f 0) * n + f 0 := by
        intro n
        have h₆ : ∀ (n : ℤ), f n = (f 1 - f 0) * n + f 0 := by
          intro n
          induction n using Int.induction_on with
          | hz =>
            simp
          | hp n ih =>
            have h₇ := h₃ n
            have h₈ := h₃ (-n - 1)
            simp [ih, add_mul, mul_add, mul_one, mul_neg, add_assoc] at h₇ h₈ ⊢
            <;> ring_nf at h₇ h₈ ⊢ <;> linarith
          | hn n ih =>
            have h₇ := h₃ n
            have h₈ := h₃ (-n - 1)
            simp [ih, add_mul, mul_add, mul_one, mul_neg, add_assoc] at h₇ h₈ ⊢
            <;> ring_nf at h₇ h₈ ⊢ <;> linarith
        exact h₆ n
      exact h₅ n
    obtain ⟨k, d, h₅⟩ := h₄
    have h₆ : (∀ (n : ℤ), f n = k * n + d) := h₅
    have h₇ : k = 0 ∨ k = N := by
      have h₈ := h₁ 0
      have h₉ := h₁ 1
      have h₁₀ := h₁ (-1)
      have h₁₁ := h₂ 0
      have h₁₂ := h₂ 1
      have h₁₃ := h₂ (-1)
      simp [h₆] at h₈ h₉ h₁₀ h₁₁ h₁₂ h₁₃
      ring_nf at h₈ h₉ h₁₀ h₁₁ h₁₂ h₁₃ ⊢
      
      have h₁₄ : k = 0 ∨ k = N := by
        have h₁₅ : k ^ 2 = N * k := by
          nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero (show (N : ℤ) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast h)]
        have h₁₆ : k * (k - N) = 0 := by linarith
        have h₁₇ : k = 0 ∨ k = N := by
          have h₁₈ : k = 0 ∨ k - N = 0 := by
            apply eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero h₁₆
          cases h₁₈ with
          | inl h₁₈ =>
            exact Or.inl h₁₈
          | inr h₁₈ =>
            have h₁₉ : k = N := by linarith
            exact Or.inr h₁₉
        exact h₁₇
      exact h₁₄
    cases h₇ with
    | inl h₇ =>
      
      have h₈ : ∀ (n : ℤ), f n = 0 := by
        intro n
        have h₉ := h₆ n
        rw [h₇] at h₉
        ring_nf at h₉ ⊢
        <;>
        (
          have h₁₀ := h₁ n
          simp [h₆, h₇] at h₁₀
          <;>
          ring_nf at h₁₀ ⊢ <;>
          omega
        )
        <;>
        omega
      
      apply Or.inl
      funext x
      rw [h₈ x]
      <;> simp
    | inr h₇ =>
      
      apply Or.inr
      use d
      funext x
      rw [h₆]
      <;> simp [h₇]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;>
      (
        have h₈ := h₁ 0
        have h₉ := h₁ 1
        simp [h₆, h₇] at h₈ h₉
        <;>
        ring_nf at h₈ h₉ ⊢ <;>
        omega
      )
  
  have h_converse : ((f = λ _ ↦ 0) ∨ ∃ c : Int, f = (N * · + c)) → (∀ a b : Int, f (N * a) + N * f b = f (f (a + b))) := by
    intro h
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      
      rw [h]
      intro a b
      simp [mul_assoc]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all
    | inr h =>
      
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h
      intro a b
      simp [mul_assoc]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all [mul_assoc]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> linarith
  
  exact ⟨h_imp, h_converse⟩
